title: Thundercut
summary:
Thundercut is an offensive spell. It creates a purple aura of electric energy, which can be used on close contact or fired from the distance. Upon contact, the target suffers significant pain from the electric discharge, and may be paralyzed. 

It is an ancient power and the sole favored spell of the Guardians of Thor.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
DeFoe used the spell. [TCG:SAS-144]

The Guardians of Thor used Thundercut multiple times throughout their attempts to stop the Huntik team from recovering Mjolnir. [Two Powers Become One]

Unnamed Suit 026 used the spell at point blank range on Dante Vale in New Grange Passage Tomb. Despite him being in serious pain, Zhalia Moon was hesitant to intervene and Dante was saved by Sabriel. [Home Turf]

Unnamed Suit 029 started casting the spell while fighting against Dante Vale in the train, but Dante dodged it. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

In Atlantis, the Mermen used this spell on Dante Vale during his test. Rassimov later used it to inflict paralyzing pain to Lok Lambert and knock him to the ground. [Coming of Age]

After discovering that Zhalia was a spy, Tantras knocked her out then started casting Thundercut to finish her off, but her powerbonding with Gareon stopped him. [Sophie on Trial]

Harrison Fears used the spell while dueling with his brother Den Fears. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Thundercut debuted in "[[Two Powers Become One]]" with a blue aura, which is also the case in the [[TCG]]. The coloration was changed to purple for every subsequent appearance.

full_text:
Thundercut is an offensive spell. It creates a purple aura of electric energy, which can be used on close contact or fired from the distance. Upon contact, the target suffers significant pain from the electric discharge, and may be paralyzed. 

It is an ancient power and the sole favored spell of the Guardians of Thor.

== History ==
DeFoe used the spell. [TCG:SAS-144]

The Guardians of Thor used Thundercut multiple times throughout their attempts to stop the Huntik team from recovering Mjolnir. [Two Powers Become One]

Unnamed Suit 026 used the spell at point blank range on Dante Vale in New Grange Passage Tomb. Despite him being in serious pain, Zhalia Moon was hesitant to intervene and Dante was saved by Sabriel. [Home Turf]

Unnamed Suit 029 started casting the spell while fighting against Dante Vale in the train, but Dante dodged it. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

In Atlantis, the Mermen used this spell on Dante Vale during his test. Rassimov later used it to inflict paralyzing pain to Lok Lambert and knock him to the ground. [Coming of Age]

After discovering that Zhalia was a spy, Tantras knocked her out then started casting Thundercut to finish her off, but her powerbonding with Gareon stopped him. [Sophie on Trial]

Harrison Fears used the spell while dueling with his brother Den Fears. [Lok and the Betrayer]

==Trivia==
* Thundercut debuted in "Two Powers Become One" with a blue aura, which is also the case in the TCG. The coloration was changed to purple for every subsequent appearance.
